title: Great day in Seville!
text: This was the perfect day tour.  Our driver, Mikel, was wonderful!  Super friendly and helpful.  Once we arrived in Seville we toured the Cathedral and palace.  Our guide was very informative.  This was a wonderful day we will never forget!
author: Susan_A

title: Seville , amazing city
text: We had a day trip to Seville. Silvia gave us a great 4 hour tour.  Although we only saw the cathedral and the Alcazar with her, history came alive. We had time to walk to the top of the Giraldo and after her tour,  had lunch nearby. Our driver took us to the exposition park with its dramatic buildings and a Venice-like canal before returning us to Granada.
author: Ellen W

title: This was an excellent trip.  We...
text:
This was an excellent trip. We really enjoyed the ride with Mike Schrave and greatly enjoyed talking to him during the 2.5 hours ride each way. He was very courteous and helpful.

The tour guide in Seville Sophia was wonderful. Without her, we would have not enjoyed the tour of Al Cazar palce in Seville. She knew the history of the palace and her knowledge of Islamic Art and Architecture shown at the palace was fascinating. I told her she was the best tour guide in Spain. It was a pleasure to meet her during our trip.
author: Jamal A

title: Seville is a wonderful city but not my...
